description: WP-11 Phase G Test F on the kinematic backend (coarse spacing allowed): 7 consecutive episodes of the C5 TRIM task in one process: scripted demonstrations (fixed and random seed), the hand-written open-loop action program (Test E), a deliberately failing scripted episode (plan stopped after PRE_CUT), an external random-delta policy rollout with deliberately invalid actions, and exact repeats of episodes 0 and 1 (same seed, same controller) for the cross-episode isolation check. return_home on the kinematic backend is NOT_APPLICABLE (no robot) and is exercised to show it.
